name: std::ratio_equal

declarations.code:
template <class R1, class R2>

struct ratio_equal : std::integral_constant<bool, /* see below */> {};

intro: If the ratios R1 and R2 are equal, provides the member constant value equal true. Otherwise, value is false.

sections.title: Helper variable template

template< class R1, class R2 >

constexpr bool ratio_equal_v = ratio_equal<R1, R2>::value;

sections.title: Possible implementation
sections.text:
template< class R1, class R2 >
struct ratio_equal : public std::integral_constant <
                                 bool,
                                 R1::num == R2::num && R1::den == R2::den
                            > {};

summary: If the ratios R1 and R2 are equal, provides the member constant value equal true. Otherwise, value is false.
